REACT_APP_BACKEND_URL ?? ''}/api` (relative fallback OK).
critical_code_review_comments: takeout.html: body cell dedupe depends on prompt string only — if the user re-asks the exact same question in a later activity entry at a different time, keys will differ (time-based) so no false dedupe; good.

imports.py:_run_job creates background tasks only tracked locally in _jobs set — if the backend process restarts mid-job the import_jobs doc stays 'running' forever (no reaper). Low-risk but worth noting.
ImportDropzone busy check uses imp.step !== 'idle' which also matches 'preview' state — not reachable here (component is swapped by ImportPage before step=preview) so no actual bug.

server.py: /api/deploy/guide + /api/deploy/bundle are not protected by auth (unlike all other /api/ endpoints). The content is static deployment docs with no secrets, so this is intentional for 'download in profile menu' UX, but noting for awareness.
nginx.conf proxy_buffering off is required for SSE — confirmed OK.
seed_data_creation: Each test cleans imported conversations before/after. After full run, imported conversations for both test@ and user2@ were deleted — fresh state restored.
context_for_next_testing_agent: Run: pytest /app/backend/tests/test_phase3_import_deploy.py -v -o 'addopts='. Fixtures at /app/tests/fixtures/takeout/{takeout-gemini.zip,MyActivity.json,MyActivity.html,invalid.json}. Preview session is 1-shot (file deleted on commit) so re-preview is needed between commits. Quota 429 retry button cannot be exercised on preview (Emergent key, no quota) — static code path only.
rca of the issue: N/A — all Phase 3 features working as spec.
